exercises.title: Test Templates
exercises.description: Use test templates for data-driven testing.
instructions: Create test 'Addition Tests' with [Template] Verify Addition
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add templated test

*** Keywords ***
# Add verification keyword
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Addition Tests
    [Template]    Verify Addition
    1    1    2
    2    3    5
    5    5    10

*** Keywords ***
Verify Addition
    [Arguments]    ${a}    ${b}    ${expected}
    ${result}    Evaluate    ${a} + ${b}
    Should Be Equal    ${result}    ${expected}
hints: [Template] makes each data row a test
Each row passes arguments to the keyword
No keyword names needed in test rows
Great for testing multiple data sets

exercises.title: Suite Variables Section
exercises.description: Define suite-level variables in Variables section.
instructions: Create test that logs both variables
exercises.solution:
*** Variables ***
${BASE_URL}    http://example.com
${TIMEOUT}    30

*** Test Cases ***
Test Variables
    Log    ${BASE_URL}
    Log    ${TIMEOUT}
hints: Variables section comes after Settings
Format: ${VAR_NAME}    value
Available to all tests in suite
Can also define lists: @{LIST} item1 item2

exercises.title: Test Timeout
exercises.description: Set timeout for test case execution.
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add test with timeout
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Fast Test
    [Timeout]    5 seconds
    Sleep    1s
    Log    Completed
hints: [Timeout] prevents tests from running too long
Can use: seconds, minutes, hours
Test fails if timeout exceeded
Can set default: Test Timeout in Settings

exercises.title: Multiple Tags
exercises.description: Use tags effectively for test organization.
instructions: Create 'Login Test' with tags: smoke, critical, api
Create 'Logout Test' with tags: smoke, api
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
# Add two tests with different tags
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Login Test
    [Tags]    smoke    critical    api
    Log    Testing login

Logout Test
    [Tags]    smoke    api
    Log    Testing logout
hints: Tags help categorize and filter tests
Run with: robot --include smoke
Exclude: robot --exclude critical
Combine: robot --include smokeANDapi

exercises.title: Force Tags
exercises.description: Apply tags to all tests in a suite using Force Tags.
exercises.initialCode:
*** Settings ***
# Add Force Tags

*** Test Cases ***
# Add two tests
exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Force Tags    regression

*** Test Cases ***
Test One
    Log    First test

Test Two
    Log    Second test
hints: Force Tags applies to ALL tests in suite
Combined with individual [Tags]
Useful for categorizing entire suites
Can add multiple: Force Tags tag1 tag2
